properties.description:
Develop the first read-only Graph editor with real relational nodes, outside the MVP. The mock exploration is finished.

Production starting-point checklist (2026-10-22)
1. Diagnose dense-edge overlap with recorded simulated inputs before changing layout behavior.
2. Add edge thickness in pixels at 100% zoom.
3. Keep node size in pixels at 100% zoom and make layout respect the displayed radius.
4. Remove total node/component/edge controls, shape picker and exclusively synthetic code/data/tests.
5. Render real nodes as white circles and real edges as white lines.
6. Implement engine-owned query operators using one expression. Defer Query editor UI redesign.
7. Add a shared splitter with the selected node's Node editor on the right.
8. Add the existing query/filter tool, applying changes only through Apply.
9. Update this task's scope and evidence.
10. Run build/types, tests for developed behavior and impacted systems; avoid the whole repository suite.
11. Provide a one- or two-line handoff summary per checklist item.

Retained agreed behavior
materialized names an engine instance; the default source is the frontend instance. Source-less queries are valid and empty. Removing a source never triggers implicit recursive discovery. Query semantics stay in Relational Engine with no planning-domain assumptions.
Use one expression with &&, || and negation. Traversal inputs are distinct from returned-result restrictions; excluding a returned node does not necessarily block traversal through it. Visible edges retain endpoints, using one Filtered placeholder per excluded endpoint. Focus uses selected node(s), maxTraversalDepth(1), both directions by default and explicit direction restriction. Exact syntax can be resolved during implementation.
Queries are applied explicitly; refresh uses the applied expression, preserving unsubmitted drafts. Reuse the agreed RefreshRadioButton: manual, manual with notification (default), automatic; each manual click refreshes, and a dot indicates newer data.
The first graph is read-only. Contextual-menu enhancements and Query editor presentation improvements are deferred. Iterate on this working view with the user.

The need-analysis child contains the verbatim interview: graph://planning-26535745-4644-4770-af7c-1980c773377b/entries/0e06b9b1-f466-41ca-9116-269a30aaa399.json.
Mock findings and evidence are recorded in: graph://planning-26535745-4644-4770-af7c-1980c773377b/entries/aa17ad61-ce88-4be7-9da5-a09f6687518a.json.

Verified production starting point, 2026-10-22
The mock-only model, worker, shapes, counts and obsolete tests have been removed. Relational UI owns a reusable CircleGraph, background collision-aware force layout, white circles/lines, selection, zoom/pan and bounded Node px (2–64) / Edge px (0.1–12), both measured at 100%. A shared splitter hosts the read-only Node editor beside it.
The engine owns one parsed expression and materialization ingestion. Supported operators: materialized("instance"), hasComponent("type"), qualified component-property predicates, isNode(), isEdge(), node.url("id"), edge.url("id"), edge.type("id"), selection(), and traverse(input, roots, maxTraversalDepth(n), optional direction("incoming"|"outgoing"|"both")). Example: traverse(materialized("frontend"), selection(), maxTraversalDepth(1)). Outside predicates restrict results; predicates inside the traversal input restrict paths. Empty/source-less queries return nothing. Filtered endpoints share a hollow placeholder. No implicit discovery occurs.
The host exposes the frontend cache and the existing broccoli-planning service engine. Default materialized("frontend") uses already received relational entities and bootstrap metadata. Planning inspections contribute their actual nodes to that cache. Explicit materialized("broccoli-planning") requests the service's already materialized collection. This iteration does not introduce recursive discovery of unmaterialized contributors or adapters for the separate repository-file projections.
The existing filter control is reused, with Apply and the accepted three refresh modes. The default is manual with notification. Draft edits do not execute; refreshing retains the applied expression and pending draft. Node selection and query/pane state survive switching away and returning. The planning service projection now includes owner-projected AttentionTracking and canonical reference edge identities.
Focused verification: 49 engine/query/planning tests, 6 shared UI/layout tests, 18 distinct impacted browser cases passed. The final graph browser case includes Apply gating, no implicit fetch, white rendered pixels, 100% sizing, placeholders, manual and automatic refresh, pan and retained view. Full .\build.ps1 passed, including organisation checks and type-safety validation across 1,083 authored source files with zero violations. The restarted live app was inspected: default frontend query returned 5 metadata nodes and 4 edges; an explicit planning query found 541 Task transition nodes; a depth-one traversal around this development task returned 6 nodes and 6 edges. Clicking the central task showed its real components and relations in the right-hand Node editor. No browser warning/error logs were reported. The whole repository test suite is intentionally not run at the user's request.

Evidence: graph://planning-26535745-4644-4770-af7c-1980c773377b/entries/b9846709-5ebb-4be7-bec7-5f0f4a7a4fd4.json (immutable live screenshot). Local validation logs: .harness/graph-real-build.log, .harness/graph-real-unit.log, .harness/graph-shared-ui-tests.log, .harness/graph-real-browser.log, .harness/graph-final-browser.log. Dense overlap reproduction and accepted output remain with the completed overlap child. The parent stays In progress for the user's next view iteration; the mock exploration and overlap child are completed.


Controls iteration — six immediate items (2026-10-22)
1. Consolidate common Node editor commands, including Copy URL, while retaining capability-specific host actions.
2. Remove the raw selected-node URL line above the Graph Node editor.
3. Place Graph query immediately after the view dropdown.
4. Reproduce and fix Fit followed by one wheel increment flickering at scrollbar appearance; continue reusing ScrollArea.
5. Add a reusable Relational UI Spinbox: value left, optional unit inside on the right, always-visible stacked up/down buttons at the far right, and wheel stepping.
6. Replace ZoomControl's percentage input with Spinbox.
Run focused affected-system tests, mandatory build/types and visual review; do not run the whole suite. Give six one- or two-line completion summaries. Consolidation may be deferred under the MVP only if it cannot reasonably fit this iteration.

Deferred query editor rework
Revisit multiline/nested expression authoring and typed interpreted-query direction. Clarify operator/function signatures and tooltips, including traverse versus maxTraversalDepth and explicit input/result scope. Improve the initial-query editing experience and visible additive/restrictive roles. Keep these changes outside the six-item controls iteration.


Controls iteration verified (six items)
1. NodeEditor owns Copy node URL alongside its existing filter and expansion controls. Planning uses that shared command, including comparisons; unsaved drafts suppress copying. Graph remains read-only, while editing/history actions stay with capable hosts. Consolidation was completed in this iteration, so no separate MVP child was needed.
2. Removed the selected node's raw URL status line from the Graph inspection panel; empty/filtered selection explanations remain.
3. Graph query is the first tool immediately after the view dropdown.
4. Fixed CircleGraph's scrollport sizing feedback loop. The shared ScrollArea is still used. Rounded client dimensions had alternately created and removed overflow at fractional display scale; CSS minimum dimensions now follow the fractional scrollport without that rounding loop.
5. Added public Relational UI Spinbox with left-aligned numerical value, optional inline unit, always-visible equal-height stacked arrows at the right, wheel and keyboard stepping, optional bounds, disabled/read-only handling and invalid-input recovery.
6. ZoomControl now delegates percentage editing to Spinbox. Fit, Reset, positive unrestricted scale entry, growing text width and viewport pointer zoom remain covered.

Validation: .\\build.ps1 completed successfully, including organisation checks and type-safety validation of 1,088 authored source files with zero violations. Eight focused unit tests and 41 distinct browser cases passed, covering Graph queries/navigation, fractional-scale scrollbar stability, Spinbox, Zoom consumers, planning saves/copying/revisions and component authoring/inspection. Final browser outcomes are collated in .harness/graph-six-verification.json. Build log: .harness/graph-six-build.log; unit log: .harness/graph-six-unit.log; focused browser logs: .harness/graph-six-final.log, .harness/graph-six-consumers.log, .harness/graph-six-spinbox-export.log and .harness/graph-six-planning-copy.log. Initial failures are retained; later focused reruns verify their unchanged expected outputs. The whole repository suite was not run.

Live app restarted and visually reviewed at its existing viewport: Graph query is beside the dropdown, the percentage has the two stacked arrows and percent unit, Copy URL returned this development task's exact canonical URL, the redundant URL line is absent, and Fit followed by a scroll increment remained stable. A depth-one traversal displayed 10 real nodes and 10 edges before the screenshot itself was attached. No browser warning/error logs were reported.
Regression recordings: graph://planning-26535745-4644-4770-af7c-1980c773377b/entries/2dddb630-5e2e-4d4c-83ed-38a84d43b0db.json. Live screenshot: graph://planning-26535745-4644-4770-af7c-1980c773377b/entries/54dfea5e-543f-4a97-b7a9-ba70f8236de2.json. The Graph development parent remains In progress; Query editor/composer rework is the next user-led iteration.
